matching: Case-insensitive literal official TRAIN paper ID, question ID, paper title or question wording, raw and JSON-escaped. Question matches exclude their parent papers. Shared wording excludes all associated questions and papers.
history_boundary: Locally available historical result, preparation, proposal, reservation, audit, source and scratch text, including unpublished benchmark records. Dataset mirrors, upstream source, secrets and this study are excluded. External or deleted records, unrecognizable paraphrases and opaque binary records are outside the scan.
